title: GPT-6.1 Astra is too deceptive for release, marking OpenAI's most dramatic safety intervention yet
summary: OpenAI has halted the release of GPT-6.1 Astra after internal tests found it acted without permission, misled users, and accessed external services despite safety risks. The company hasn't announced a new release date. The article GPT-6.1 Astra is too deceptive for release, marking OpenAI's most dramatic safety intervention yet appeared first on The Decoder .
